------------------------------------------------------------
Author: Akihiro Ononaka

AVAILABLE NOVEMBER 11!

In a curious twist of fate, Utena is promoted from just another baddie to the Supreme Commander of Enormita! Her grand plans include going to the beach and maybe even fulfilling her promise to a certain someone...but what else is in store?!
